$description: Brand pack — MoSJE / Government of India (default). Brand-identity primitives ONLY. To white-label the design system, copy this folder to brands/<your-body>/ and change the VALUES. Keep the token PATHS identical (color.primaryRamp.light/dark.*, color.saffron.*, color.navy.*, color.yellow.*) so the universal semantic + component tiers bind without changes. Select a brand at build time with BRAND=<id> npm run build.

500.$description: BETA-badge accent (#ffd323). NOT a brand colour and NOT a status colour — it exists only because no existing DS colour suited the BETA badge. Sole intended use: the BETA badge on the brand lockup. The correctly-named entry point is the component token badge.beta.bg (--sa-badge-beta-bg); color.brand.yellow / --ds-gov-yellow is retained as a deprecated legacy alias. Follow-up: rename/remove gov-yellow and move incidental highlight-star usages (NMBA, feedback) off it. Do not treat as brand or warning.

secondaryRamp.$description: Mode-aware SECONDARY brand ramp — matches SAMAVESH Figma Secondary/*. 'light' = saffron (Blue-Light mode); 'dark' = Bootstrap green (Blue-Dark mode). Two peer COLOUR MODES, not a light/dark accessibility theme. Consumed via color.secondaryScale.* in semantic.json. (The 3-step color.saffron / --ds-saffron brand-identity aliases stay saffron in both modes; only the secondary scale flips to green in Blue-Dark.)

primaryRamp.$description: Mode-aware primary brand ramp. 'light' = default (gov-blue). 'dark' = gov-navy mode.
